input.quote: 18.14 Counterparts; Other Matters. This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no insurance covenant anywhere: searches for insurance return only Net Sales deduction references in Article I (p0101, p0102), and Article XVIII General Provisions ends at 18.14 with no coverage obligation, notwithstanding Array's indemnity and recall exposure under Article XVI. We therefore insert a short Section 18.15 at the fallback level (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber and privacy USD 2,000,000) immediately after 18.14, keeping the rest of the General Provisions untouched. We did not add the preferred general liability, workers' compensation or certificate elements, which remain available if Array prefers the fuller package.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 18.15 (Insurance) requiring Array to carry E&O of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability of at least USD 2,000,000.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, so we have added a short Section 18.15 at our fallback level requiring Array to carry errors and omissions cover of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability cover of at least USD 2,000,000. We are happy to discuss our preferred general liability and higher cyber limits if you prefer that structure.

ops.text: Insurance. Array shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
